description.fun: Buzzwole is a mosquito from the Ultra Jungle with the build of a bodybuilder: it sucks up energy through its proboscis, which is harder than diamond, and its body swells into muscles stronger than steel. A single punch can wreck a dump truck. It strikes a pose every time it does anything, maybe to communicate, though nobody's sure. Its designer was James Turner.
description.guide: Buzzwole is a Bug- and Fighting-type Ultra Beast, codenamed UB-02 Absorption, based on a mosquito with huge muscles. It absorbs energy through its proboscis to strengthen its body. It is the heaviest Bug-type Pokémon and a version counterpart to Pheromosa.
description.tagline: A body-building mosquito that strikes a pose with every move
